parameters.jsCode: const raw=$input.first().json;const x=raw.body||raw;const transcription_job_id=x.transcription_job_id||x.transcript_id||x.provider_job_id||x.id||'';const episode_id=x.episode_id||x.metadata?.episode_id||x.record?.episode_id||'';const callback=Boolean(raw.body);const callbackAllowed=false;const rawThreshold=x.context_risk_review_threshold;const threshold=rawThreshold!==undefined&&rawThreshold!==null&&String(rawThreshold).trim()!==''?Number(rawThreshold):NaN;return [{json:{...x,episode_id,transcription_job_id,provider_state:String(x.status||x.transcription_status||x.state||'configuration_hold').toLowerCase(),stage_run_key:x.stage_run_key||'',test_mode:x.test_mode!==false,allow_external_writes:x.allow_external_writes===true,allow_transcription_read:x.allow_transcription_read===true,allow_error_writes:x.allow_error_writes===true,context_risk_review_threshold:Number.isFinite(threshold)?threshold:null,normalization_source:callback?'disabled_callback':'authenticated_polling',callback_allowed:callbackAllowed,last_completed_stage:String(x.last_completed_stage||'TRANSCRIPTION_SUBMITTED')}}];

parameters.jsCode: const raw=$input.first().json;const body=raw.body||raw;const id=String(body.transcript_id||'');const status=String(body.status||'').toLowerCase();const uuid=/^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[1-5][0-9a-f]{3}-[89ab][0-9a-f]{3}-[0-9a-f]{12}$/i.test(id);return [{json:{...raw,transcript_id:id,callback_status:status,callback_signature_valid:false,callback_signature_fail_closed:true,callback_contract_valid:uuid&&['completed','error'].includes(status),callback_disabled_reason:'secure static-header comparison is not configured; use authenticated polling'}}];

Code - Normalize And Validate AssemblyAI Transcript

parameters.jsCode: const r=$input.first().json;const source=$('Code - Restore AssemblyAI Status Read Context').item.json;const body=r.provider_response||r.response||r.data||r;const status=String(body.status||'').toLowerCase();const words=(Array.isArray(body.words)?body.words:[]).map((w,i)=>({index:i,text:String(w.text||'').trim(),speaker:String(w.speaker||'UNKNOWN'),start_ms:Number(w.start),end_ms:Number(w.end),confidence:Number(w.confidence)}));const utterances=(Array.isArray(body.utterances)?body.utterances:[]).map(u=>({text:String(u.text||''),start_ms:Number(u.start),end_ms:Number(u.end),confidence:Number(u.confidence),speaker:String(u.speaker||'UNKNOWN'),words:Array.isArray(u.words)?u.words:[]}));const errors=[];if(status!=='completed')errors.push('status_not_completed');if(!String(body.text||'').trim())errors.push('text_missing');if(!words.length)errors.push('words_missing');if(!utterances.length)errors.push('utterances_missing');for(let i=0;i<words.length;i++){const w=words[i];if(!w.text||!Number.isFinite(w.start_ms)||!Number.isFinite(w.end_ms)||w.end_ms<=w.start_ms)errors.push('invalid_word_'+i);if(i&&w.start_ms<words[i-1].start_ms)errors.push('unsorted_word_'+i);}const normalized_transcript={episode_id:source.episode_id,transcription_job_id:source.transcription_job_id||body.id||'',status,text:String(body.text||''),audio_duration:Number(body.audio_duration),speech_model_used:String(body.speech_model_used||''),speakers:[...new Set(words.map(w=>w.speaker))],words,utterances};return [{json:{...source,provider_response:body,normalized_transcript,transcript_contract_valid:errors.length===0,transcript_contract_errors:errors,last_completed_stage:errors.length?'TRANSCRIPTION_SUBMITTED':'TRANSCRIPTION_COMPLETED'}}];

parameters.jsCode: const rows=$input.all();const source=$('Code - Check Transcription Storage Configuration').first().json;const record=rows.map(i=>i.json).find(j=>j&&Object.keys(j).length&&(j.id||j.fields));const f=record?.fields||record||{};let stored={};try{stored=typeof f.result_json==='string'?JSON.parse(f.result_json):f.result_json||{};}catch{}return [{json:{...source,processing_event_found:Boolean(record),processing_event_complete:String(f.status||'').toUpperCase()==='COMPLETED',stored_stage_result:stored,stored_provider_job_id:f.provider_job_id||'',stored_drive_file_id:f.drive_file_id||''}}];

parameters.jsCode: const input=$input.first().json;let seeded={};try{seeded=$('Code - Check Transcription Storage Configuration').first().json||seeded;}catch{}const x={...seeded,...input};const text=String(x.error?.message||x.error_message||x.message||'Boundary operation failed').replace(/(?:bearer|token|key|secret|authorization)[^\s]*/ig,'[REDACTED]');return [{json:{workflow_name:"Transcription Completion",execution_id:$execution.id,stage:"TRANSCRIPTION_COMPLETION",episode_id:x.episode_id||'',asset_id:x.asset_id||'',asset_version:Number(x.asset_version||0),stage_run_key:x.computed_stage_run_key||x.stage_run_key||'',attempt_number:Number(x.attempt_number||1),error_code:String(x.error?.code||x.error_code||'BOUNDARY_FAILURE'),error_message:text.slice(0,500),retryable:Boolean(x.retryable),test_mode:x.test_mode!==false,allow_external_writes:false,allow_error_writes:x.allow_error_writes===true,last_completed_stage:String(x.last_completed_stage||seeded.last_completed_stage||'')}}];
